description: exp_g_0024 - the DECOMPRESSION-ONLY variant, sitting between exp_n_0045 (compress + decompress) and exp_g_0023 (neither). The FFN slot keeps exp_g_0023's no-compression routing -- inner_in_dim=-1, so has_compress is False, compress is nn.Identity and the LUT routes on the FULL 384-d slot input -- but ADDS BACK the decompress stage with inner_out_dim=48, giving a real Linear(1*48 -> 384). Table cells are therefore 48 wide instead of 384, which is what keeps the parameter count near exp_n_0045's rather than exp_g_0023's 620M. Routing mirrors exp_g_0023: n_heads=1, nap=7, tph=2048, hard, learnable_temps. Everything else identical to exp_n_0045/exp_g_0023: MinimalGPT depth 6, n_embd 384, n_head 6, plain Linear attention, seq 512, vocab 32768, tied unembedder, AdamW, 24,576 tok/step, 16,000 steps, seed 1. ffn_lut_kind selects all three variants: 'compression' | 'decompress_only' | 'fastmhl_raw'. Shared lutorch NOT modified. MEMORY FIX: device_batch_size 48 -> 12 with grad_accum 4 and eval_steps 10 -> 40. tokens/step stays exactly 24,576 and the validation budget stays exactly 245,760 tokens (40*12*512 == 10*48*512), so nothing scientific changes -- only the per-micro-batch memory footprint. At device_batch_size 48 this OOMs in the BACKWARD on a 32 GB card; exp_n_0045's reference run used an 80 GB H100, which is why the original batch was viable there and is not here.
